chosen_args.why_stop: S1: candidate_13 is feasible and optimized as current lowest cost. S2: no unresolved candidate remains: higher-activity candidates candidate_04 and candidate_05 were optimized and are costlier; all lower-activity higher-price candidates are screened by the declared rule. S3: candidate_04, the highest-activity candidate, differs from candidate_13 and its activity-parity multiplier and reachability were computed; the required 201.2x improvement is unreachable on the frozen descriptor scaling manifold. S4: remaining affordable checks have low expected decision value and are unlikely to change the constrained-domain industrial decision.
